basic_info.description: Have you have ever dreamed of living in San Francisco & Paris & the Italian Wine Countryside, but want them all at the same time? If so, prepare to fall in LOVE with 49 Liberty St#3. Located in the heart of Liberty Hill Historic district, with greenery, mature trees & picturesque SF icons this is city living at its finest. This gracious condo & amazing backyard are a serene, city retreat within steps of city's culturally vibrant Mission Dolores & Mission Districts. This exceptionally chic & sophisticated 1BR/1BA condo is part of a spectacular 1880 Italianate Victorian 4-Unit Bldg. With outlooks to picturesque Liberty St, the rooms have soaring ceilings, softwood floors, beautiful chandeliers, & stunning architectural detailing. The sunlit kitchen has French doors opening to your exclusive deck & truly one of the most magical backyards in SF.Shared with the other units, this south-facing backyard is over 1,500 sq ft of professionally designed & landscaped gardens, stone walkways, & a fabulous outdoor eating area. Perfect for enjoying morning coffee or large scale entertaining, this oasis will have you feeling as if you've been transported to a wonderful Wine Country retreat. Good storage, laundry & garage parking. This exceptional property is a rare San Francisco jewel.
